title: Importing between documents refuses differing linked styles, and Word files in another language
symptom: import_fragment (Rust, Python) and Python insert_document fail with "invalid style graph: linked styles ... are not reciprocal" when both documents define a linked style pair differently, and with "style type ... has more than one default" from a Word file saved in another language; Rust insert_document panics with these messages, and Rust append panics on a Word file in another language and when the destination's paragraph style has no link (Google Docs files)
workaround: for differing linked styles, import with FragmentConflictPolicy::rename_all() or with_style_reuse(false) (Rust and Python); none for a localized Word file
